meta.name: prompts.json
meta.description: 1.0.0-RELEASE - Project consolidation rules and shell standards
meta.notes: Merged consolidation rules: zsh/ksh preference, scan limits, bash→zsh conversion, PR automation.

scan.note: Iterate depth=1..max_depth to avoid API limits.

conversion.strict_mode: set -euo pipefail; emulate -L zsh; setopt extended_glob null_glob

coding_style.note: Prefer clear multi-line constructs over cryptic one-liners, heavy pipe chains, and concatenated expressions.

conversion.openbsd_compatibility_note: If a construct is incompatible with ksh/OpenBSD, use POSIX-safe alternatives or add a brief ksh-fallback comment.

github_workflow.pr_restore_policy: apply closed PR commits first, then open PRs; create CONFLICTS_RESTORE.md on conflicts and stop
github_workflow.note: Require CI checks before automerging restored changes.

consolidation.placeholder_policy: create README.md listing expected sources when target files are missing
consolidation.note: This file governs consolidation. Backup at ai3/prompts.json.bak.
